name: shellOS
line: a desktop shell drawn in pure Bend
question: Can a desktop shell drawn pixel by pixel in Bend move from Linux to macOS without changing the app?
body: Bend series, part 3. A single-window desktop shell drawn pixel by pixel in pure Bend (terminal over a real PTY, reader, palette), ported from a Linux VM to macOS with no app changes, three screen-only bugs fixed, then redesigned.
alt: shellOS after the redesign: panes for themes, saved articles, items, the reader and a live terminal
